I want you to really look at these two photos. Because one of them was called "my choice."
The top photo: me, after I broke free. 
The bottom photo: me in Iran, buried in fabric in the water, full hijab and people call this a choice.

You know what that choice looked like? 

They told us; Cover yourself head to toe and go to heaven. Or don't cover and be hanged by your hair and burned in hell for eternity. They taught me this as a little girl.

I use to call it a choice the way a prisoner choose
